# pcall

Call a function in protected mode.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.pcall` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `pcall(function_name, ...)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `pcall(function_name, arg)` |

## Example

```lua
pcall(function_name, arg)
```
